triggerComment: The obligation to notify was triggered by an acquisition of shares (Acquisition Position Obligation). With Recommendations of the Disclosure Office dated 15 July 2016, 17 June 2019, 8 July 2022 and 11 July 2025, BlackRock, Inc. was granted easing provisions from the obligation to disclose the direct shareholders according to Article 120 para. 1 FinMIA in conjunction with Article 11 let. b and Article 22 para. 1 let. e and para. 3 FinMIO-FINMA when disclosing holdings according to Article 18 para. 1 and 4 FinMIO-FINMA. However, collective investment schemes within the meaning of Article 18 para. 2 let. a FinMIO-FINMA that hold individually 3% or more of the voting rights of the relevant issuer will be mentioned in the relevant disclosure notification. Any person shall, at his/her request and without prove of interest, receive information about the direct shareholders within the meaning of Article 11 let. b an Article 22 para. 1 let. e and para. 3 FinMIO-FINMA.  Such request has to be addressed via email to the Disclosure Office: disclosure-office@six-group.com. The information will be provided in electronic format with a reference date not older than one month.  The easing provisions are granted until 15 July 2028.

triggerComment: In the recommendation of 14th July 2025, the Disclosure Office has exempted UBS Group AG with regard to equity securities in DocMorris AG from the reporting obligation pursuant to Art. 16 para. 2 in conjunction with Art. 22 para. 3 FinMIO-FINMA in the event of the addition or discontinuation of group companies completely controlled by it as direct participants. Accordingly, disclosure reports with regard to equity securities to DocMorris AG are required only if reporting obligations arise for other reasons. The Disclosure Office has granted this relief for a limited period until 2 August 2027. Any person or issuer may, without proof of interest, request UBS Group AG to inform in writing and free of charge, about the current direct participants within a period of two trading days. The inquiry should be sent to: UBS Group AG, Uetlibergstrasse 231, 8045 Zürich, Konstantina Georgaki, +41-44-239 40 71, sh-gsp-emea@ubs.com.
